global.who_is_fabio_content:
Dear Guests,

In Sharm El Sheikh, you will find hundreds of vendors offering you "the lowest price." I have made a different choice: to offer you the highest quality.

My catalog does not contain everything, only the best. I have personally selected every boat, every guide, and every corner of the desert to guarantee you three things that are priceless: Safety, Privacy, and Magic.

Who is Fabio? More than a friend, an institution.

Entrusting your vacation to someone is a matter of trust. This is why I am different:

Excellence & Legality

A graduate in Languages (Al-Alsun) and an Official Guide authorized by the Ministry. In Sharm, where unlicensed operators are common, choosing me means choosing certified competence.

VIP Service (Flight Attendant)

My other office is "the sky." As a Flight Attendant, I combine the warmth of Egyptian hospitality with the precision of international standards.

Guests, Not Numbers

While others cram you into crowded buses, I choose substance: Private cars, total flexibility, and zero surprises.

The Value of Memories

Remember: an excursion ruined to save a few euros... ends up costing you very dearly.

"Quality has a price, but your most beautiful memories are priceless."

items.q: Do I have to pay everything online?
items.a: Absolutely not. Trust is everything. We usually ask for a small deposit to secure spots (especially for VIP boats), and the balance is paid comfortably upon arrival in Sharm, in cash or local currency. No risk, zero stress.

items.q: How do I know the exact pickup time?
items.a: Forget the anxiety! The night before every excursion, you will receive a personal WhatsApp message from Fabio with the exact time, meeting point, and transfer details. Swiss organization, Egyptian heart.

items.q: What happens if plans change or I get sick?
items.a: We are humans, not robots! If something comes up, message us on WhatsApp immediately. We'll do our best to reschedule without extra costs. ⚠️ Exception: For flights (Cairo/Luxor), we depend on airline rules, so flight tickets are non-refundable.

items.q: Do I need a Visa for excursions?
items.a: Crucial detail: If you stay in Sharm (e.g., Safari), the free 'Only Sinai' stamp is enough. But if you choose Ras Mohammed (by land) or go to Cairo/Luxor, you MUST buy the Egypt Visa ($25) upon arrival. Ask us if unsure!

Keyword: Comfort. Desert: closed shoes, sunglasses, scarf. Sea: swimwear, sunscreen. Insider Tip: Always bring a light hoodie, even in summer, for the strong A/C in buses or the desert breeze at night.

Insider Tip: Bring Euros/Dollars for hotels and tours (accepted everywhere). Exchange a small amount into Egyptian Pounds for small expenses: taxis, tips, and markets. Paying small things in local currency saves you money!
Hotel Wi-Fi is often slow. Golden advice: Buy a Data SIM (Vodafone or Etisalat) directly at the airport upon arrival. It's cheap and gives you fast internet everywhere.
Drink ONLY sealed bottled water (even for brushing teeth). For food, during our excursions, we select only certified restaurants with high hygiene standards.
